releaseGate: M31 Full Editor Dogfood Release Gate

features.title: Edit and View Commands
features.implementation: Typed command availability, dispatch, diagnostics, URL state, keyboard and pointer activation.

features.title: CSS Property Editors
features.implementation: Typed CSS value parsing, normalization, source-plan selection, validation, shared-scope handling, undo/redo, dirty state, save staging, raw CSS section editing, cascade origin indicators, copy/paste/reset property actions, Figma-style numeric scrub/step controls with pointer drag, coordinate-driven color-picker affordances, unit chips, and visual border-radius, shadow, and Bezier timing controls.
features.playwrightReason: The implemented contract is headless value/edit-engine behavior; browser form control coverage is included indirectly through the edit-button and consumer browser suites.

features.title: Real Component DOM Editing
features.implementation: Component edit mode renders the project-owned preview iframe, installs a generic DOM selection and hover-inspection bridge with selection handles, supports deep element selection, repeat-click parent cycling, Shift-click component wrapper selection, breadcrumb/source-path context, maps clicked real DOM to InspectorVM source-backed properties, applies inspector edits live in the iframe, and routes representative color, spacing, raw CSS, style copy/paste, and Figma-grade inspector affordance edits through the workspace source adapter with dirty/save/revert state.

playwrightTests.name: edits real metacraft component DOM through the inspector

features.title: Foundation Token Editors
features.implementation: Token edits, impact analysis, contrast validation, semantic alias cycle validation, and source-plan generation.
features.playwrightReason: The release gate exposes foundation editing as source-backed ViewModel behavior; no browser-only rendering or pointer behavior is owned by this feature.

features.title: Component Variant Editors
features.implementation: Variant fixture/story metadata validation, field edits, and source-plan generation.
features.playwrightReason: The variant editor contract is source/schema state; consumer component rendering is covered by the browser consumer suite.

features.title: SVG and Vector Editors
features.implementation: Fabric-backed canvas interaction, Paper.js-backed boolean/path-segment operations, SVGO-backed export, source-backed properties, undo/redo, diagnostics for unsupported freeform Bezier editing, and M27 save bridging.

features.title: Workspace Source Synchronization
features.implementation: Adapter-mediated transactions, same-file composition, conflicts, rollback, targeted reload, full reload fallback, and generated-view roundtrip.
features.playwrightReason: Source synchronization is intentionally headless and adapter-owned; browser save buttons are covered by vector and agent browser tests.

features.title: Agent-Assisted Edits
features.implementation: Structured prompt context, ACP/Agent Harbor event mapping through nim-agents, permission state, proposal review, partial accept, reject, revert, cancel, error, completion, and M27 save path.

features.title: Browser Back and Forward Navigation
features.implementation: Route serialization, popstate handling, URL-driven view/mode/selection restoration, and consumer browser compatibility.

playwrightTests.name: keeps editor state in browser history

features.title: Journey and Vector Pan/Zoom
features.implementation: Figma-style journey canvas zoom/pan state plus Fabric vector zoom/pan behavior.

headlessTests.name: storyboard exposes figma-style zoom and pan state

playwrightTests.name: supports figma-style zooming and panning on flow pages

features.title: Sidebar Search
features.implementation: Search filtering preserves group metadata and page/component/journey selection semantics.

playwrightTests.name: mounts the live consumer workspace through public editor APIs

features.title: Sidebar and Inspector Panels
features.implementation: Top-level navigation sections, collapsible panels, responsive visibility, empty states, and inspector toggles.

headlessTests.name: sidebar sections expose top level editor navigation

playwrightTests.name: mounts the live consumer workspace through public editor APIs

features.title: Package Imports and Consumer Boundary
features.implementation: Public native and browser import surfaces compile for the example, metacraft-web, and CodeTracer-facing workspace patterns without private editor imports.
features.playwrightReason: Browser package import compatibility is compiled by tests/test_editor_public_browser_imports.nim and exercised by the example/consumer browser suites.
